basis: R1473 Clang retains one extra MIPS dispatch instruction per decode; R1475 eliminates redundant zeroing of tied operand indices.

R1473 GCC adds one Ir, Dr and Dw per AArch64 decode inside cs_decode_full_insn. The fallback architecture is known, but MCInst_Init remains an external call with a generic SystemZ dialect test. Inline the existing full-initialization owner and test whether this removes the measured call-boundary cost.
change: Use the existing owning full initializer inline with constant CS_ARCH_AARCH64 in the exact four-backend fallback. Continue complete operand clearing for AArch64. Retain R1475 partial-initializer range splitting.
invariant: cs_open rejects unavailable architectures. In exact ARM/AArch64/MIPS/X86 builds, X86 and ARM/MIPS have already selected their initializers; only AArch64 can reach the full fallback.
validation: ARM records, poisoned operands and read-before-construction observer; AArch64 full public records/cursors/errors across both byte orders, text/detail/skip options and truncated or malformed words; mcinst complete-byte default checks for all enum values. Then codegen gate and native controls.
codegen_gate: Before native timing, no increase in fixed-guest Ir for AArch64 raw, MIPS detail, PE32 format or PE64 format. ARM hosts report unavailable Callgrind and retain native timings.
